name: Forest Packaging Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Forest Packaging Group Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the entire process of packaging paper, from its initial research and development to manufacturing and sales. The company provides both foundational base paper and ready-made corrugated cardboard boxes. Its extensive product range features various items, including paper cups, pizza boxes, gift boxes, general paper products, cardboard shoe boxes, and diverse food packaging solutions. This enterprise was founded on September 3, 1998, and operates from its main office located in Wenling, China.
